remarks: Serene pond views in one of the best spots in the desirable Old Greenwich Complex. Enter to an airy and sunny open layout with high ceilings and sky lights. An updated kitchen with pass through window and adjacent dining space. Area below stairs a perfect display for a spirit of wine collection. The dining flows to a living room punctuated by a wall of windows and a sliding door to an intimate deck overlooking the fountain. Upstairs the main bedroom suite. A spacious bedroom with a walk in closet, en suite bath, and huge loft. Perfect for a home office or guest space. Situated on the Greenwich/Stamford border easily access the village of Old Greenwich and Tod's Point Beach. Storage, laundry in unit, heat and hot water included. Dogs OK. Unit available March 1st.
